info.title: Phonebook App
info.description: Phonebook app allowes to store user's contacts in the database, edit them, and access to them from anywhere on Earth having internet connection.

get.summary: Get a list of the user's contacts
get.description: Get **an array** of objects representing **the contacts** created by the user. </br> Use **filters** as query parameters to narrow down the server response. </br> **Sort** response by the specific parameter in ascending or descending order. </br> Use **pagination** by passing the page number and number of contacts per page in the query parameters.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: All contacts's fields can be mentioned.

schema.description: The filter parameter that narrows down the response by the contact type.

post.description: **Create** a new contact.Request contains **a body** as a **json** object with contact update data or **multipart/formdata** body that can contain avatar image.

requestBody.description: Provide data of the new contact .

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the contact

contactType.description: Contact group by area of their use

photo.description: The file of the contact's avatar image uploaded to the cloud or server

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the contact

contactType.description: Contact group by area of their use

get.summary: Get a contact by its id
get.description: **Get** an object representing the **contact** by its **id** passed as an url parameter [/contacts/:contactId](/contacts/:contactId). </br> Parameter **contactId** must be a valid id: 24 hexadecimal symbols.

delete.summary: Delete the user's contact by its id
delete.description: **Delete** an object representing the **contact** by its **id** passed as an url parameter [/contacts/:contactId](/contacts/:contactId). </br> Parameter **contactId** must be a valid id: 24 hexadecimal symbols.

put.description: **Update** existing contact or **create** the new one if it's absent in the database. Request contains **a body** as a **json** object with contact update data or **multipart/formdata** body that can contain avatar image

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the contact

contactType.description: Contact group by area of their use

patch.description: **Patch** existing contact by its id. Request contains **a body** as a **json** object with contact update data or **multipart/formdata** body that can contain avatar image

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the contact

contactType.description: Contact group by area of their use

post.description: **Register** a new user. Credentials pair is valid email and password. **Ensure** that password is strong.
**Login** an user. Credentials pair is valid email and password.
**Login** an user. Credentials pair is valid email and password.
**Refresh** a user session. Use this endpoint to get a new pair of a sessionId and refreshToken in cookie and an access token in the response json body, if access token is expired.
**Send email** to the user to reset its password. **Provide** an user email address to which the server should send an email with a password reset link.

email.description: The email address to get the password reset link.

post.description: **Reset** the user's password. **Provide** a signed JSON web token contained information about the user and a new password to the reset.

requestBody.description: Data to reset the user's password

token.description: A JSON web token with info about the **user**: {**userId, email**} and a **time stamp** when it expires.

get.description: **Get** google auth URL to use it in GET HTTP request to get an user code with permission and user data.

post.description: **Login** with google OAuth API. Pass in the request JSON body code gotten from the same name query parameter of URL that the google consent screen redirects to.

code.description: The **code** query parameter retrieved from the URL to which google consent screen redirects. </br> **This URL** looks like: </br> [http://domain-name.com/auth/confirm-oauth?**code=4%2F0Ab_5qlk0KhUUB4nN9ThyM9dTe4_fUvUOet8Vwab2B9pAG1ds5cvLq3KGaGrkHOznH5dF-g**&scope=email+profile+openid+https%3A%2F%2Fwww.googleapis.com%2Fauth%2Fuserinfo.email+https%3A%2F%2Fwww.googleapis.com%2Fauth%2Fuserinfo.profile&authuser=8&prompt=none]()

schema.description: The session id. It's set by the backend server.
The refresh token to get a new session id in cookie  and an access token in json body of the server response. It's set by the backend server.
